events.summary: Taylor Murphy announced joining Mercury to lead its data engineering and platform team.
events.headline: Taylor Murphy joins Mercury as Head of Data Engineering & Platform

events.summary: Mercury added wire drawdowns so payroll providers such as Sequoia and Gusto can withdraw funds directly from eligible Mercury accounts.
events.headline: Payroll-provider wire drawdowns

events.summary: Business and Personal accounts provided through Column can send real-time payments through the API, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
events.headline: Real-time payments via the Mercury API

events.summary: Plus and Pro customers began receiving faster priority support while 24/7 support remained available to all customers.
events.headline: Priority Support added to Plus and Pro

events.summary: Customers can connect multiple Mercury accounts for direct transfers and schedule recurring transfers to external bank accounts.
events.headline: Connected Mercury accounts and recurring external transfers

events.summary: Users can ask ChatGPT or Claude to move money, pay recipients, or categorize transactions, with approval required before money moves.
events.headline: Mercury actions in ChatGPT and Claude

events.summary: Applicants can use a completed Form SS-4 while their EIN is pending, then provide the EIN within 90 days of approval.
events.headline: Applications opened with a pending EIN

events.summary: Mercury launched W-2 and 1099 payroll, benefits, and compliance support in all 50 states; it is free for eligible customers through 2026 and then priced at $100 per month plus $50 per person paid.
events.headline: Mercury Payroll launched

events.summary: Mercury introduced a Treasury experience built around monthly business outflows, including personalized portfolios and U.S. Treasury bond ladders; eligibility requires at least $250,000 across Mercury accounts.
events.headline: Mercury Treasury, reinvented

events.summary: Mercury launched controls for connected AI agents, including permissions, approvals, spending limits, activity tracking, and the ability to disconnect agents.
events.headline: Mercury Agent Controls
